method: Both models use the same registry factory, default configuration and device. The reference calls the layer builder directly for the previous TorchScript representation. The candidate uses the public build_model default. A strict state_dict load makes weights identical for each pair. CPU timing pairs use seed 21. V100 pairs use the 1aa0f8b snapshot, built in FP32 before moving to the measured dtype. Inference compares E and Fa. Training additionally compares all active weight gradients. The formal systems also use the archived 1aa0f8b V100 outputs as a direct reference.
inputs: Nine atoms in two molecules, 8 x 16 and 32 x 20 molecules on CPU. V100 uses the nine-atom case and the three acceptance systems (32 x 20, periodic 256 and 2000 atoms).
timing: Two-thread workers alternate the two models in a single process. Four warm-up pairs precede each measurement. A CPU repeat starts in the opposite order for any shape with an initial pooled median regression over 3%. Pooled and order-specific medians are reported. Both resident models share the same starting allocation during paired peak-memory measurements.
compiled_check: Ordinary torch.compile through the public model. The recording backend invokes Inductor, requires learned operations and real generated kernels, and compares energy, forces, and all parameter gradients from sum(E**2)+sum(Fa**2) to the original eager model. Dtype-specific element tolerances are 5e-4 (FP32) and 1e-8 (FP64).

unit_checks.64fa3ce: 28 passed, including both original architecture snapshots.
unit_checks.6f20494: 26 passed on a separate compute node. Coverage includes state-dict keys, stock e3nn checkpoints, module deepcopy, torch.save/load with map_location, CUDA-independent meta transfers, buffer storage aliases and full tensor-product TorchScript export. Another 12 passed for preset symmetry and full module dtype transfer.

construction.processor: Intel Xeon Gold 6130, separate two-thread process on login-2
construction.method: Each model has two fresh processes, swapping which implementation builds first. Twelve subsequent construction times per implementation alternate order, excluding the first pair in each process.

legacy_reference_gradients.processor: Intel Xeon Gold 6130, two CPU threads, separate from the compute-node timings
legacy_reference_gradients.method: A fresh process on the 1aa0f8b source checkout computes native E, Fa and all active gradients for each formal system and precision. A second process runs 6f20494 with the same FP32 checkpoint and measurement dtype. Explicit architecture-specific snapshot name rules map the old parameter names before comparison.

compiled_performance.method: Same frozen FP32 checkpoint and physical V100 for both source checkouts in each pair. The ordinary torch.compile entry point runs the three systems in that order; inference and energy-plus-force training on each system precede the next. A fresh process loads each side. Times and peak allocated memory are medians of timed repetitions. Each ABBA side aggregates its two process medians. Missing baseline numbers remain unavailable.
